enrollment_discounts_value_chk.name: enrollment_discounts_value_chk
enrollment_discounts_value_chk.value: ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'FREE' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is null) or ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'PERCENT' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is not null and "enrollment_discounts"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("enrollment_discounts"."type" = 'AMOUNT' and "enrollment_discounts"."value" is not null and "enrollment_discounts"."value" > 0)

enrollment_discounts_dates_chk.name: enrollment_discounts_dates_chk
enrollment_discounts_dates_chk.value: "enrollment_discounts"."to_date" is null or "enrollment_discounts"."from_date" is null or "enrollment_discounts"."to_date" >= "enrollment_discounts"."from_date"

expenses_void_chk.name: expenses_void_chk
expenses_void_chk.value: ("expenses"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("expenses"."voided_at" is not null and "expenses"."void_reason" is not null)

groups_billing_day_chk.name: groups_billing_day_chk
groups_billing_day_chk.value: ("groups"."billing_mode" = 'GROUP_CYCLE' and "groups"."billing_day" is not null and "groups"."billing_day" between 1 and 28) or ("groups"."billing_mode" = 'STUDENT_CYCLE' and "groups"."billing_day" is null)

groups_dates_chk.name: groups_dates_chk
groups_dates_chk.value: "groups"."end_date" is null or "groups"."start_date" is null or "groups"."end_date" >= "groups"."start_date"

payments_amount_chk.name: payments_amount_chk
payments_amount_chk.value: ("payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null and "payments"."amount" > 0) or ("payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null and "payments"."amount" < 0)

payroll_payouts_amount_chk.name: payroll_payouts_amount_chk
payroll_payouts_amount_chk.value: ("payroll_payouts"."reverses_payout_id" is null and "payroll_payouts"."amount" > 0) or ("payroll_payouts"."reverses_payout_id" is not null and "payroll_payouts"."amount" < 0)

payroll_rules_value_chk.name: payroll_rules_value_chk
payroll_rules_value_chk.value: ("payroll_rules"."type" = 'PERCENT' and "payroll_rules"."percent" is not null and "payroll_rules"."percent" > 0 and "payroll_rules"."percent" <= 100 and "payroll_rules"."percent_base" is not null and "payroll_rules"."percent_base" in ('PAID','CHARGED') and "payroll_rules"."amount" is null) or ("payroll_rules"."type" <> 'PERCENT' and "payroll_rules"."amount" is not null and "payroll_rules"."amount" > 0 and "payroll_rules"."percent" is null and "payroll_rules"."percent_base" is null)
